records.name: Hermes Agent
records.one_liner: Persistent personal-agent platform combining a coding loop, memory, skills, delegation and a multi-channel gateway; source-level Python embedding is possible but not a supported wheel API.

dims.loop: AIAgent coordinates provider calls, bounded tool dispatch, steering, interruption and context-pressure recovery; max turns is unlimited by default unless configured.
dims.providers: Multiple provider adapters and compatible endpoints, with explicit provider-specific authentication, message conversion, caching and retry handling.
dims.tools: Built-in coding, process, search, memory, delegation and integration tools; registry/toolsets, MCP ingestion and result filtering.
dims.context: Stable prompt prefix, project instructions, persistent memory and skills; replaceable context-engine lifecycle with compression and oversized-result handling.
dims.state: SQLite WAL sessions, incremental tool-result persistence, ownership leases and gateway/delivery recovery; not deterministic replay of arbitrary in-flight tool effects.
dims.safety: Approvals and child policy propagation; optional Docker/remote execution, egress controls and credential proxy. Default local execution is host execution.
dims.extensibility: Plugins, hooks, skills, tools, providers and context engines; broad product extension seams, with API stability distinct from product releases.
dims.multi_agent: Parallel delegation, named background work, opt-in child worktrees, routed profiles, kanban handoffs, mixture-of-agents and A2A capabilities.
dims.surfaces: CLI/TUI, headless, gateway HTTP and messaging channels, web/desktop, ACP and MCP servers; Python imports require a source checkout.
dims.observability: Trajectories, session search, usage and service monitoring. Optional OTLP exporter carries redacted gateway health events; turn tracing is a separate Langfuse plugin.

builds_on: Python provider SDKs and compatible APIs
Optional Docker, remote execution and MCP integrations
used_by: First-party Hermes CLI, gateway and web/desktop surfaces
key_insights: Distinguish the supported product from source-checkout AIAgent embedding.
Recovery and delivery custody are stronger than saved chat history, but arbitrary effects are not journal-replayed.
Skills can be learned at configured intervals after eligible turns, rather than necessarily after every turn.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Documented source-checkout Python use; no supported installable wheel contract.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Optional configured backend; local execution defaults to the host.
features_notes.otel: Gateway health/diagnostic OTLP events, not built-in GenAI turn/tool spans.
features_notes.plan_mode: Not established in the reviewed source.

limitations: Static review only; no runtime or crash tests.
Inherited detailed chapter received targeted claim review and all citation-path/range validation; not every statement was independently rerun.
Release metadata checked via first-party GitHub API; popularity is not scored.

independent_final_review.scope: Source samples of scheduling, package and persistence boundaries
corrections: Qualified recurring cron occurrence deduplication versus finite one-shot dispatch budgets and unlimited one-shots.
